subject: Quarterly rollforward: Open Harbor expansion plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@openharbor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quarterly rollforward: Open Harbor expansion plan

Hi Emily —

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick follow on our product usage trend: Q4 and early Q1 telemetry shows sustained growth in throughput across your teams (see attached MSP Q4 usage). We discussed an incremental expansion to add 3 reserved GPU slices for two new teams starting May 1.

To keep forecasting tidy for finance, can you confirm these three things by end of week?
1) Target start date for pilot (May 1 or later)
2) Internal approval owner and expected PO timeline
3) Any procurement or security sign-offs we should route early

If you prefer, Monica (cc'd) can host a 30-min handshake with your SRE and procurement to speed approvals. I've attached an updated mutual action plan (v3) and a draft SOW that reflects the May start.

Thanks — looking to lock this into our Q2 expansion commit if timelines hold.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: OpenHarbor_MSP_Q4_usage.xlsx (spreadsheet), Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf (PDF), SOW_OpenHarbor_Q2_draft.docx (DOCX)
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@openharbor.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly rollforward: Open Harbor expansion plan

Ben —

Thanks for the summary and the materials. We're definitely interested in the expansion; usage has spiked as predicted. Quick answers:
1) Pilot start: tentatively May 3 (we prefer first Monday after the holiday)
2) Approval owner: Sarah Lin (Director, Platform) — she owns procurement sign-off and should review the SOW
3) Security/compliance: will need a short SOC 2 evidence review; security has requested network diagrams and retention controls.

I've attached our internal procurement timeline (PO_timeline_OpenHarbor.pdf). Monica, can we set the handshake for next week? Sarah will join if available.

—Emily
Emily Zhang
VP, Engineering | Open Harbor Logistics
emily.zhang@openharbor.com | +1 206-555-0124

Attachment: PO_timeline_OpenHarbor.pdf

Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quarterly rollforward: Open Harbor expansion plan — internal sync

Team —

Looping to get Salesforce/HubSpot updated and to make sure finance has visibility for the Q2 commit. Action items from my side and asks:
- Ben: update HubSpot stage to "Expansion — Contracting" and add Sarah Lin as the procurement contact (HubSpot link below). Please include the PO timeline Emily sent.
- Marissa: can you run the last-90-day usage delta and confirm the ARR uplift estimate? I want a defensible uplift number for the commit.
- Grace: please schedule the technical handshake with Emily+Sarah for Tues 9 Mar or Wed 10 Mar. Monica will lead the security evidence walkthrough.
- Vivek: FYI — we may need a one-off credit structure while we ramp; want to align on how this will appear in forecast if pilot slips by two weeks.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Thanks — trying to close timing gap so we can include the deal in next week's finance commit.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly rollforward: Open Harbor expansion plan

Emily / Team —

Following internal checks, here's the clean set for forecast:
- Proposed uplift: $78,000 ARR (3 reserved GPU slices; 12-month term)
- Pilot start: May 3, 2027; commercial start aligned to pilot success (90-day pilot)
- Preconditions: SOC2 evidence review complete; signed SOW and PO on file

Links: SOW draft (attached), DocuSign temp link: https://www.docusign.com/receipt/ABCDEF123456

Monica and Marissa have the action items for usage validation and security kickoff. If you can confirm Sarah Lin and PO timing by Friday 12 Mar, finance has given conditional approval to include this in the Q2 committed pipeline on our side.

Folks —

Quick note from finance: we can tentatively include the $78k ARR uplift in the commit for Q2 provided:
- SOW signed or digitally executed by 12 Mar
- PO on file before May 1 (pilot start)
- Any agreed ramp credits documented in the SOW (if applicable)

If Ben can confirm Sarah Lin as approver and Emily can confirm the PO cadence, we'll lock this into the weekly commit. Otherwise we'll treat it as a high-probability upside but not in the committed number.
